Author: NightmareXIV
Name: Stylist
Description: Gear manager that will watch your gearset for possible upgrades and upgrade them via single command.
Changelog: Validated fork update from source 5aba1536fc7b617525b502655266947155cd5d73. Storage sorting now uses the game's native IsItemRegisteredToGearset marker check on each inventory item. Marked items go to the armory chest; unmarked armory items go to regular inventory. Removes all custom saved-set scans and ID/quality/appearance matching. Uses the original Stylist emblem recoloured in the fork-family green-to-magenta palette. Build, storage, merge-policy and package checks passed. Existing IPC identity is preserved. Development preview; native UI acceptance testing remains separate.
